-WARNING-
Photosensitivity: By default, this game contains flashing lights, screen effects, and rapid visual changes that may disturb some individuals. Check settings before playing. If you are prone to seizures, do not play.

AB is the latest implimentation of the D.E.E.Z. vision, which is based on the Undertale & Deltarune franchises by Toby Fox and their AUs.
**This is NOT a 'Battlegrounds' genre game.

-TUTORIAL IN-GAME-
Menu -> Gamemodes (Controller Icon) -> Tutorial (On the left)

-NOTICE-
Participants found engaging in the following may be removed from AB:
- Use of external tools or exploits that interfere with integrity.
- Harassment or targeted abuse toward other participants in & between instances.

Anomalies may occur. Deliberate and repeated use of them may result in your removal.
